segments.oily: Reviewers with oily/combination skin describe the stick as greasy and not fully setting, and one says it is probably not suited to oily skin, though another with combination skin reports no breakouts.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dry-normal skin report the formula feels hydrating and moisturizing, though one dry-skin reviewer describes it as leaving skin dry and uncomfortable with splotchy coverage.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin find it greasy in hot/humid weather but also report it did not break out their skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report no stinging or irritation, and one with sensitive, acne-prone skin says it gives a flawless glow without issues.
segments.normal: One reviewer states the product is nice for normal skin.
segments.mature: One reviewer values the mineral SPF for helping prevent wrinkles alongside acne-scar protection, but no dedicated mature-skin complaints or praise beyond this are detailed.

concerns.aging: One reviewer credits the mineral SPF with helping prevent wrinkles and damage; otherwise anti-aging effects are not detailed.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the formula as hydrating, soothing, and non-sticky, improving dryness; one reviewer, however, reports it left skin feeling dry and uncomfortable.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports it stopped her nose from looking red after wiping, describing it as covering redness effectively.
concerns.barrier: No reviewer specifically discusses barrier repair or damage.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with acne scarring reports the tint helps camouflage discoloration and scarring for a more even look.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with acne-prone skin reports no breakouts and a flawless glow; another with combination skin also reports the formula did not cause breakouts, but one reviewer found it too greasy to layer without looking oily.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers with oily or combination skin find it too greasy, especially in hot/humid climates, describing a slick finish that never fully sets; one counter-review says it wears without oily residue and is not greasy at all.

extraits.texte: Too greasy. It's like applying a stick of shea butter on my face. When I saw shea butter in the ingredients I didn't know it would be so much. Can't even layer it or else I'll look like I applied straight oil to my face.

I gave 4 stars because it is quite greasy for my oily/combination skin especially here in texas the weather is hot/humid. Maybe this would be good during colder days. But overall it is great for reapplying and the tint is not too dark and orangey.
Great product, glides on easily. Just wish there was a smidge more color to the tint. Nice for normal or dry skin. Probably not for oily skin.

I love this stick because I hate putting on liquid sunscreen and this also gives you a bit of a glow and it's super easy to put makeup on top. I had the original stick and not the tinted but I definitely prefer the tinted, no white last at all for me! I also have dry-normal skin and this is amazing hydration too.

extraits.titre: The perfect on the go version of the Tinted Creme!
extraits.texte: If you love the tinted creme, you'll love this. Hands down, it is always in my purse for on-the-go reapplication. I have super sensitive, acne-prone skin and this helps gives me a flawless glow and also Mineral SPF protection to prevent wrinkles or damage to my acne scarring!

Gifted by MDSolarSciences. I love how simple this product is to apply. I just rub the stick onto my face. It's tinted so there's no white cast. I have combination skin and this formula didn't break out my skin. Overall, a beautiful product and I like it so much!
Splotchy uneven coverage. Leaves skin feeling dry and uncomfortable.
